objective: Rebuild the repaired CUDA image on Linux x86, then qualify BF16 LoRA on one Standard A100 without training the model.

required_explicit_scope: upload generation-pinned workspace/controller inputs to the existing GCS bucket
create one temporary VPC, subnet, router, and NAT for the CPU prebuild
create one Standard e2-standard-8 CPU prebuild VM with a 200 GB boot disk
create one Standard a2-highgpu-1g A100 40 GB qualification VM without external IP or NAT
read and write only run-scoped GCS evidence and artifacts
stop and delete every VM only after terminal evidence is backed up and independently verified
delete the temporary NAT, router, subnet, and VPC after verified terminal backup

prebuild.network: temporary NAT for package/image build only
prebuild.required_output: content-sealed repaired CUDA image archive plus offline dependency bundle in generation-pinned GCS

qualification.network: no external IP, no NAT, network-disabled qualification container
qualification.scope: package, CUDA/Triton/FLA identity; text-only model load; adapter target/gradient smoke; bounded peak-VRAM qualification

mandatory_sequence: freeze and hash local workspace/controller/model inputs
after explicit approval, upload inputs to generation-pinned GCS objects
create temporary CPU network and prebuild VM
build, export, hash, and back up the repaired image and offline bundle
independently verify the complete GCS prebuild inventory
stop and delete the CPU VM; remove NAT and router
create the no-NAT Standard A100 VM from generation-pinned inputs
back up terminal logs, raw outputs, identities, hashes, and result to GCS
independently verify the terminal GCS inventory
stop and delete the A100 VM, then delete subnet and VPC
prove all run-scoped compute and network resources absent
hard_stops: no explicit GCloud approval for this card
input, generation, size, or SHA-256 mismatch
more than one GPU is visible
CUDA, Triton, FLA, package, model, adapter, gradient, merge, or VRAM check fails
terminal backup or independent verification fails
success_boundary: Gate 0B passes only if the repaired image and A100 qualification both pass with complete sealed evidence; otherwise preserve the failure and tear down.
